stopPoints.label: Mummy Pig notices holes in George's washed clothes in the kitchen
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Story/Problem): 'Look at George's clothes! Why are they giggling?' (Prompt: His clothes have holes in them / They are wet) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'His clothes have holes in them!'
Q2 (Observation/Body): 'What can Peppa see through the hole in George's pants?' (Prompt: George's bottom / His hand) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'George's bottom!'
Q3 (Observation/Details): 'Look at the white fridge behind George. What yellow magnet do you see?' (Prompt: A yellow duck / A banana) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'A yellow duck!'

stopPoints.label: George tries on a colorful clown outfit in Miss Rabbit's clothes shop
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Story/Pretend): 'George came out of the changing booth! What does he look like?' (Prompt: A clown / A policeman) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He looks like a clown!'
Q2 (Feeling): 'Does George want to dress like a silly clown?' (Prompt: No, he doesn't / Yes, he does) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'No, he doesn't like it!'
Q3 (Observation/Item): 'What is spinning on George's colorful hat?' (Prompt: A little propeller / A flower) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'A propeller on the hat!'

stopPoints.label: George is happy to get brand new blue clothes that look just like him
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Color/Clothes): 'George found his favorite clothes! What color is his shirt now?' (Prompt: Blue / Red) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'It is blue!'
Q2 (Action/Emotion): 'Look at George in the mirror! What is he doing because he is so happy?' (Prompt: Jumping up and down / Sleeping) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'He is jumping!'
Q3 (Story/Comparison): 'What is special about these new clothes?' (Prompt: They are just like his old ones, but with no holes / They have a cape) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'The same as before, but no holes!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa and her family jump in muddy puddles and roll around laughing
stopPoints.question:
Q1 (Action): 'Everyone is out in the garden! What are they jumping and rolling in?' (Prompt: Muddy puddles / Cold snow) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'Muddy puddles!'
Q2 (Counting): 'How many pigs are covered in brown mud and lying on the ground?' (Prompt: Four / Two) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'One, two, three, four pigs!'
Q3 (Observation/Weather): 'Look up at the bright blue sky! What is shining brightly above them?' (Prompt: The yellow sun / A rainbow) ➔ Guidance: Encourage child to say: 'The sun!'
